**Considering the rat race idiom**

I'm thinking about the idiom "rat race" and how it connects to the hectic nature of work life. The first part mentions small grey animals, like mice or rats, linked to the idea of death. Then, there's the aspect of fast road transport associated with racing. So, my guess is that "rat race" captures the essence of the work grind. I also wonder if greyhound racing came to mind because of the greyhound breed.
